verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents persistent browser sessions, and its API reference covers browser-session endpoints, so programmatic session management exists. Nothing in the pack shows running a concurrent fleet or documents concurrency limits; 'organization limits' is not described as session concurrency. missing for 10: documented concurrent-session/parallelism support, published concurrency limits per plan, details of session lifecycle API (create/list/close), independent corroboration at scale.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can run a fleet of concurrent browser sessions with documented concurrency limits and programmatic session management

citations.quote: covering agents, runs, browser sessions and credentials
Cookies, local storage, open tabs, and the current page all persist, so later operations pick up exactly where the previous one stopped.
